acceptanceCriteria: An explicit iPhone Play action configures an approved playback session and produces the selected shared-renderer tone through an AVAudioEngine output host.
Stop, selection, pitch, timbre, level, interruption, route loss, and engine failure converge on truthful stopped or unavailable UI state without implicit restart.
The render callback consumes preallocated buffers and does not allocate, block, perform I/O, or mutate UI-observed state.
notes: Planning complete. The current ContentView changes a request flag only; this Task owns the missing audible iPhone integration.
